purpose: Phone-proportioned exterior gate with more substantial columns
prompt:
Create a revised production background asset from this gate reference for a tall phone app. Keep same Jewish siddur title-page gate identity, antique champagne gold, crown above blank paired tablets with foliage, horizontal classical lintel, two classical columns, bottom threshold, warm ivory background. NO TEXT and NO UI.
CRITICAL new composition: output a TALL PORTRAIT 1024 x 2048 image, approximately 1:2 ratio, purpose-designed for a phone rather than vertically stretched from a shorter picture. The columns must be STRONGER, THICKER and visually grounded: column shafts about 85 pixels wide (8.3% canvas width), naturally modelled with intact circular bases and capitals, no unnaturally elongated decorations. Move the columns outward toward side margins, so the clear unobstructed interior opening remains broad: inner column edges near x=150 and x=874. Top crown and lintel fit above y=230, capitals end around y=300. Bottom plinth and threshold occupy last 120 pixels, with compact plinths starting y=1860. Columns span long middle section but sturdy substantial diameter and fine classical fluting make them feel architectural rather than stretched. The clear central interior is blank luminous ivory, uniformly clean and subtly textured, ready for real HTML text and controls. No horizontal bars or decorations crossing the middle. All text will be added separately. Shallow low-relief matte gold, realistic delicate detail. Preserve warmth, elegance and sacred heritage of reference. Avoid skinny poles, huge top crown, deep stairs, excessively bulky corner blocks, distorted capital shapes, high shine, perspective camera, and any labels. Front-facing orthographic symmetrical gate frame. All ornaments remain in image bounds with tiny outer margin.
